text:
incidents-bot: ALERT: p99 latency breach for streaming route /v1/chat (region: us-west) — current p99 2.4s, p95 820ms. Paging oncall: @ana :rotating_light:

ana (oncall): seeing it, ack. pulling metrics now. any recent deploys?

miguel: yes, we rolled out calib_profile_v3 to int8 yesterday at 02:12 UTC for most inference pools. No automatic rollback triggered.

ana (oncall): copying logs. miguel, can you confirm which pools got the profile?

miguel: prod-gpu-a and prod-gpu-b. about 60% traffic on those.

leo: timeline — tail token latency started climbing ~03:40 UTC, correlates with calibration jobs hitting KV-cache churn. p95 increased gradually, p99 spiked at 04:02 UTC.

jess (prod-support): any customers impacted yet? We have one ticket from Acme (low volume) complaining of stream stalls. CS is preparing a heads-up note.

ria (customer-ops): flagged two customers on dedicated capacity — they reported timeouts on long-context streams. working on messaging.

ana (oncall): immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback calib_profile_v3 on prod pools, 2) route streaming to fallback fp16 variant, 3) throttle calibration jobs. miguel/evan which is fastest?

ev an (eng-runtime): fastest is routing fallback to fp16 for new streams. rollback requires a careful rollback of calibration state and a restart of the runtime slices (10-15m). throttling calibration is safe but effect will be delayed.

miguel: agree with evan. we can flip routing policy via control plane: `redwoodctl routing set --route /v1/chat --preferred precision=fp16 --scope prod-gpu-*` — this should steer new connections within ~30s.

ana (oncall): do it. prefer minimizing customer disruption. miguel, run it and post command output. jess, draft short customer note: "We are rerouting streaming to a stable precision to restore latency; no model content change."

miguel: running now.
```
redwoodctl routing set --route /v1/chat --preferred precision=fp16 --scope prod-gpu-*
Applying policy to 4 runtime groups... done. Active pull windows ~25s.
```

miguel: policy applied. ops-bot shows routing events 04:15:36 UTC.

ops-bot: ROUTE_CHANGE: /v1/chat -> preferred precision=fp16 (applied to prod-gpu-a,b,c,d) by miguel at 04:15:36 UTC

leo: metrics: new streams p95 dropped to 260ms within 70s of change, p99 down to 780ms, tail stalls count reduced 87%. good signal.

jess (prod-support): sent initial customer note to impacted list, waiting on final numbers to update.

ana (oncall): next steps: 1) keep fp16 routing for 2 hours, 2) throttle further calibration jobs, 3) prep rollback playbook only if fp16 shows regressions. miguel, throttle command?

miguel: `redwoodctl calib throttle --profile calib_profile_v3 --limit 0.05` reduces calibration job rate to 5%. applying.

miguel: applied throttle, jobs dropping.

evan (eng-runtime): note: we saw some KV cache eviction spikes during calib runs — long-context sessions got primed causing eviction storms. need a follow-up to improve calibration access patterns. filing RFC.

ria (customer-ops): customers acknowledged the routing fix, one customer requested an ETA for full restoration of int8. we'll provide a timeline after root cause triage.

ana (oncall): creating incident ticket INC-2255 and tagging SRE and ML infra. I'll hand off to miguel for deep triage and to prepare rollback docs if needed. Oncall handoff in ~45m to @miguel.

miguel: taking lead for triage. current status: mitigated (traffic routed to fp16). impact: degraded p95/p99 for ~40 min affecting streaming long-context requests for some customers. severity: sev3 -> escalated to sev2 while identifying cause, but declining now due to mitigation.

jess (prod-support): prepping postmortem template and customer timeline. adding affected customers list.

ana (oncall): thanks all — leave thread open. miguel, please post final RCA and whether we decide to reintroduce calibrated int8 with a revised rollout plan. handoff to miguel at 04:45 UTC. :white_check_mark:

miguel: will follow up in this thread once we finish log correlation and calibration telemetry analysis. expected update in 2 hours.

ops-bot: INCIDENT INC-2255 created by ana (oncall) at 04:20 UTC. severity=2, status=mitigated (routing fallback applied).

ana (oncall): handing to miguel — oncall out in ~15.

miguel: acknowledged, taking over.

--- end of thread ---
